Name: BigDumbYak's Home Spa Seasonal Textures
Author: BigDumbYak
Description:
Bring your [b]Home Spa[/b] to life with fully seasonal exterior textures that blend naturally into Stardew Valley’s world. This Content Patcher add‑on swaps the spa’s appearance automatically for [b]spring, summer, fall, and winter[/b], matching the game’s visual style and keeping your farm feeling cohesive year‑round.

This pack is designed to work alongside the original [b]Home Spa[/b] mod by BigDumbYak, which adds a placeable hot spring and sauna to your farm. You can find the main mod here:

[b]Home Spa (Nexus Mods)[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41614]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41614
[/url]
The seasonal textures apply automatically and require no configuration. If you use a non‑English game language, the pack will still load correctly and display the appropriate seasonal look.

Perfect for players who love immersion, visual polish, and a farm that changes with the seasons.
